title: Graph centrality
tests_run: python -m pytest tests/intelligence/test_graph_store.py tests/intelligence/test_graph_builder.py tests/intelligence/test_graph_traversal.py tests/intelligence/test_graph_centrality.py tests/intelligence/test_boundaries.py -q -p no:cacheprovider
tests_passed: 760 full CRIBA tests passed; 1 pre-existing dependency deprecation warning
decisions: Centrality is unweighted degree centrality over unique neighbors, normalized by N-1.
Centrality uses the complete ordered node list by default and supports an induced requested subset.
NetworkX remains unnecessary for the deterministic metric required by P06-T04.
risks: The metric is undirected degree centrality even though traversal and shortest_path are directed; this is explicit and should not be silently reused as in-degree/out-degree centrality.
Unknown ids in a requested subset receive a score of zero when isolated from known ids.
follow_up: BF-P00-T06 golden validation in an isolated copy; do not overwrite live tracked artifacts
